area: Pre-push hard-blocks on historical commits lacking a work-admission ticket
finding: The pre-push commit-range guard emits ATM_WRITE_TICKET_HISTORICAL_ATTESTATION_REQUIRED as a blocking finding for commits that predate the work-admission ticket contract, so a single ungoverned commit anywhere after the accepted baseline blocks every subsequent push until an emergency attestation is minted. The hook already separates this concern correctly one level up: ATM_HOOK_PRE_PUSH_GIT_HEAD_EVIDENCE_MISSING_DIAGNOSTIC is emitted at info level with the text 'This is diagnostic only; same-commit governed provenance and closeout-boundary evidence remain the strict checks.' The ticket requirement contradicts that stated policy by re-entering the same range as a hard finding.
expectedBehavior: Historical gaps must remain diagnostic while same-commit governed provenance stays strict, which is the policy the hook's own message already states. A push must not be permanently unavailable because history contains a commit made before the contract existed or through an audited bypass. Whatever the resolution, it is an owner-level policy decision about whether ungoverned history can be pushed at all, so it must be adjudicated rather than silently relaxed or silently kept.
evidenceOrRepro: node --strip-types scripts/validate-framework-governance-repairs.ts --mode validate at HEAD c486a50413c7ea3865adf218d69bb9550431b607. The fixture creates a critical commit with hooks bypassed via core.hooksPath pointing at an empty directory, then asserts 'pre-push must stay passable when historical git-head evidence is missing'. The assertion was made self-diagnosing before being read: observed codes ATM_HOOK_PRE_PUSH_FAILED, ATM_HOOK_PRE_PUSH_GIT_HEAD_EVIDENCE_MISSING_DIAGNOSTIC; findings ["ATM_WRITE_TICKET_HISTORICAL_ATTESTATION_REQUIRED"]. hardFailure in packages/cli/src/commands/hook/pre-push.ts is computed from report.findings.length > 0, so the single historical finding is sufficient to fail the push.
followUp: Adjudicate whether the historical ticket requirement belongs in the pre-push blocking set at all. If it stays, the accepted-baseline mechanism must be able to absorb pre-contract history without an emergency lease per push, otherwise the repository is one ungoverned commit away from being unpushable. If it becomes diagnostic, keep same-commit governed provenance and closeout-boundary evidence strict, and add a negative control proving a same-commit ticket violation still blocks. Related: the same over-reach of the ticket gate into surfaces it was not scoped for is tracked as ATM-BUG-2026-08-13-003. Keep the observed-codes and findings diagnostics added to this assertion; without them the failure named no code at all.
